import openpyxl
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

# Load the workbook
spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/40467/1_40467_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/40467_1_b699bde1/1_40467_output.xlsx"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Load workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Update cells D1 to D10
for row in range(1, 11):
    # Get the datetime values from columns B and C
    b_value = ws[f'B{row}'].value
    c_value = ws[f'C{row}'].value
    
    # Format dates as "dd-MMM" (e.g., "01-Jan")
    if isinstance(b_value, datetime) and isinstance(c_value, datetime):
        b_formatted = b_value.strftime('%d-%b')
        c_formatted = c_value.strftime('%d-%b')
        
        # Create the string "From {B_date} to {C_date}"
        result_string = f"From {b_formatted} to {c_formatted}"
        
        # Write to column D
        ws[f'D{row}'].value = result_string

# Save the workbook
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"File saved to {output_path}")

# Verify the changes
wb_check = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path)
ws_check = wb_check['Sheet1']
print("\nVerification - Updated D column values:")
for row in range(1, 11):
    print(f"D{row}: {ws_check[f'D{row}'].value}")

    # Create a formula that uses TEXT function to format the dates

    formula = f'="From "&TEXT(B{row},"dd-mmm")&" to "&TEXT(C{row},"dd-mmm")'
